description: Use this to create or edit the printed 5x7 postcard: a greeting on the front over or under the photo, and a message and sign-off on the back. Pass the photo the user attached as photo, or a public https image URL as photo_url; the image is downloaded and stored on cards.onmax.me. Without a photo the front is the greeting on a solid color. Pass design_id to edit a design: given fields replace the old values and omitted fields keep them. Use the message the user wrote or approved, up to 500 characters. Places the user's photo and text in a print template; does not generate images.

greeting.description: Front headline, e.g. "Happy Holidays", "Merry Christmas", "Thank You".

photo.description: Photo the user attached for the front.

photo_url.description: Public https URL of the front photo.

sign_off.description: Signature on the back, e.g. "Love, The Garcias".

style.description: classic (red), evergreen (green), winter (blue), minimal (white), thanks (warm, for thank-you cards).

name: design_card
title: Design card
